steps.en: Local vehicles awaiting ownership are sent to LTA for checking
steps.id: Kendaraan lokal yang menunggu data pemilik dikirim ke LTA untuk dicek

steps.en: Owner name, ID and ID type from LTA are saved on the notice
steps.id: Nama, ID, dan jenis ID pemilik dari LTA disimpan di notice
steps.why_en: A reported fault let some notices move on without any owner data; whether it is fixed cannot be proven.
steps.why_id: Ada laporan notice lanjut tanpa data pemilik; belum bisa dibuktikan sudah diperbaiki atau belum.

steps.en: The owner's ID type is identified from the LTA code
steps.id: Jenis ID pemilik dikenali dari kode LTA

steps.en: Each notice goes to the follow-up that fits its ID type
steps.id: Setiap notice diarahkan ke tindak lanjut sesuai jenis ID
steps.why_en: Some notices were reported moving on without an owner, and the full follow-up rules are not in the code.
steps.why_id: Ada laporan notice lanjut tanpa pemilik, dan aturan follow-up lengkap tidak ada di code.
